v0.116.0 released (SX Bet): https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v0.116.0

WHAT YOU DO: 1) sx.bet > Account > API: create a key with ONLY 'Market data: read'. 2) In the app: Settings > SX Bet: paste the key, switch on; Settings > APIs > Test. 3) Settings > Cloud scan > Send my API keys to GitHub (puts it in SXBET_API_KEY for the engine). Then tell me and I'll check the first real answers (my frame conversion is built from the docs, not yet verified with a live key). Still to build: SX live scores/odds in the live lane.
